gold.user: A project manager wants to redact sensitive information from a document before sharing it with external stakeholders. They prepare the document and send a POST request to the redaction API with the necessary parameters.
gold.ideal: The API successfully processes the request and returns a job ID that can be used to track the redaction status.

gold.user: After submitting a redaction request, the project manager needs to check the status of the redaction job. They replace {jobId} with the actual job ID received from the previous response and send a GET request to the status endpoint.
gold.ideal: The API returns the current status of the redaction job, indicating whether it is still processing, completed, or failed.
